notes.title: Epitasis - Version 1.05!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29993236/4fde7d8d628294e59ff041eee96d5a4e67b1386f.png[/img]

Hello everyone,

With the release of Epitasis on console platforms, this brings bug fixes and improvements to PC as well, notably including a brand new main menu, pause system, and enhanced controller support.

[h2]Version 1.05[/h2]
New menu update along with various bug fixes and improvements...

[list]
[*] New main menu and pause system
[*] Updates to controller support in menus
[*] Refined adjustable graphics, gameplay, and audio settings menus/functionality
[*] Auto exposure / auto gamma adjusted
[*] Updates to game saving and user profiles
[*] Upgraded to latest Unreal Engine 4.27
[/list]

[h2]New Price and Sale[/h2]
With the game released for console platforms, and Epitasis having been out for almost 3 years now, we have made the decision to drop the price of the game to a standard $14.99 USD across all storefronts. With this and the release of Version 1.05, the game also has a week long sale for PC, starting today!

We're extremely grateful for everyone who has supported Epitasis and has helped make this possible. We are excited to finally close this chapter. With this release, development of our next title can now truly begin. 

Cheers,
Lucas

notes.title: Epitasis - Version 1.04 Released and One Year Anniversary Sale
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Lucas here with an important update on Epitasis.

As you all may know, its been quite a while since the last update to the game - in fact, practically since launch. 

After the release of the game, I took a small break and then began working on the console port of the game for both Xbox One and Playstation 4. These ports have taken much longer than anticipated as a solo developer, and one thing that ended up needing to happen was a major engine upgrade. The engine upgrade was about 3 years apart, and thus this took a ton of time to get up and running again on both Windows and Mac. We also implemented a lot of infrastructure as a studio to better situate ourselves for more regular updates that are easier to produce for both platforms and future products, which was a major bottleneck previously. 

I'm happy to say that Epitasis is now running on the latest version of Unreal Engine 4, and with it comes major stability and bug fixes. In addition, a major complaint  - lighting during night time - has been fixed, with the lighting at night now being totally revamped across the entire game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29993236/b3d3b47913b8f6ac03a8e9768766efb3fc1a9e25.jpg[/img]

[h3]Version 1.04[/h3]
[list]
[*] Night time lighting update - the lighting at night now has a nice blue moonlight to help players see better
[*] Auto exposure / auto gamma adjusted
[*] Steam Achievements sometimes not unlocking fixed
[*] Version number added to main menu
[*] Content updates from Version 1.02 and 1.03 have been localized
[*] MacOS content depot now contains Ultra HD wallpapers
[*] MacOS startup issues fixed as game is now 64bit (game compiled on latest Xcode 11.4, UE4 4.24, MacOS Catalina 10.15.4)
[*] MacOS ending and credits video fixed as would occasionally appear just black
[*] MacOS distance field shadows not displaying fixed
[*] Windows 10 startup issues fixed for certain players
[*] Various savegame issues fixed
[/list]

[h3]Sale[/h3]
To support this rather large update and to celebrate the 1 year anniversary of the games launch, Epitasis is on sale for 40% off for the next week - the lowest it's ever been on sale. As a single developer, I also really want to thank everyone for supporting Epitasis and being patient during these times. Thank you. 

Additionally, If you've not yet left a review for the game, doing so would be extremely helpful! 

Lastly, [url=https://epitasisgames.com]Epitasis Games now has a new website[/url]. You can check there for additional blog posts and any future games. We also have new social media pages on [url=https://twitter.com/epitasisgames]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/epitasisgames/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/epitasisgames/]Facebook[/url]. 

Thank you everyone!
Lucas 
Epitasis Games

notes.title: Epitasis - Version 1.03
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I've pushed a new update to Steam, fixing various issues people are currently having:

Version 1.03
[list]
[*] Refined the Circle area's large water drone puzzle. 
[*] MacOS issue where running the game on OS X 10.12 caused an error.
[*] MacOS issue with lighting distance fixed.
[*] Fixed an area you could get stuck at the campsite level near fences.
[*] Fixed an issue in the ending where [spoiler]it was possible to get stuck under the middle platforms while moving up.[/spoiler]
[/list]

These changes are now live. Please let me know if you run into any additional issues. 

Planning on another update for this weekend that continues to fix some issues, namely redesign for a Grasslands puzzle (Triangle area), night time darkness, and keybindings. Thank you for your continued patience! 

Cheers,
Lucas

notes.title: Epitasis - Version 1.02
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I've pushed a new update to Steam, fixing some top issues people are currently having:

Version 1.02
[list]
[*] Ending Changes - [spoiler]I have completely remodified the ending to remove the anti-gravity mechanic. It is now more in line with the rest of the game. I hope you like it, and let me know if you have any more issues with it in our discussion forums.[/spoiler].
[*] You can now return to the main hub of the game after going to the ending level. 
[*] Introduction translations fixed.
[*] Warning added to new game button if a save already exists.
[*] Default brightness increased when starting the game for the first time (increases brightness slider default value in graphics settings).
[*] Cubes can no longer get stuck in your face sometimes.
[*] Added an AZERTY keyboard option - I'm working on a keybinding feature for a future update, so this is a band-aid for now. Located in Options -> Player.
[*] Added extra cubes in the Grasslands level with lots of small structures. This reduces back and forth time of carrying cubes. 
[*] Removed harmful red lasers as there was very few and they were inconsistent to the overall experience of the rest of the game.
[*] Fixed a bug where the drone could disappear while moving to activate a requested button, leaving you stuck. 
[*] Regressed an issue where you could get a cube stuck in the Hexagon Planetary Hologram level.
[*] Mentioned in the previous update, but Oculus software will no longer start when starting up the game.
[*] Fixed a couple of missing textures in one of the Grasslands levels. 
[/list]

Thank you to everyone who has helped find issues and provided feedback on the game! We're very grateful to see such an active community for the game already and hope we can continue polishing the game as much as possible with everyone's help. There's still a few other things I'd like to address soon such as keybindings, a rare issue with the mouse/cursor, an ending issue on MacOS with the movie, and just general feedback. 

Thank you!
Lucas

notes.title: Epitasis Post-Launch Update / Hotfix
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 

The response to the release has a been a bit overwhelming - glad to see so many people jumping in and enjoying the game for its relaxing atmosphere, scenery, and music. All the screenshots have been very awesome to see, along with the discussion forums and people helping each other out with puzzles too! 

[h1]Media Roundup[/h1]

There's been a few walkthroughs, gameplay videos, and articles on Epitasis so far, feel free to check out some of them here:

Some nice gameplay:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=j1qFi7Id3hQ

An honest review from Gameumentary:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5z1QpNikies
(issue with ending addressed below, tl;dr : I'm working to fix it up!)

[url=https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/2019/05/01/epitasis-released/]Epitasis on Rock Paper Shotgun[/url]

[h1]Fixes / Issues[/h1]

[b]I've uploaded a patch to Steam that fixes a few quick issues that people have been having[/b]:
[list]
[*] MacOS City Ruins area crashing
[*] Made the ending area a little bit easier to complete with [spoiler] the gravity well.[/spoiler] We are going to work on fixing this area up more plus be more suitable for the game, since it seems like some have difficulty with it. 
[*] VR software loading when the game starts
[*] Developer Settings in pause menu removed 
[/list]

In addition to all this, there is a few other issues we're still investigating. [b]I'm hoping to have fixes for these sometime this weekend when I have more time to correct them[/b]:
[list]
[*] Some achievements are not firing for certain users 
[*] French keyboard layout
[*] Volume sliders not working for some users
[*] Translations for the intro got reset during an earlier fix right before the games launch (all other translations in the game should be OK)
[*] MacOS issue with ending credits/video
[*] Big cube-drone puzzle issues
[/list]

If you run into any other issues please let me know and I will work on fixing them as soon as I can! I have been trying to keep an eye on the discussion forums and investigate any issues that sound strange. 

I appreciate all the understanding as we move forward in fixing any and all issues with the game. Since I am a solo-dev and full time student, it is easy for me to miss small details and get bogged down, but I hope through our community here on Steam we can get any and all issues fixed up in a timely manner. 

Thank you everyone for your support and for checking out Epitasis so far. :)

Cheers!

Lucas

notes.title: Epitasis Launches May 1st! New Trailer and Details
notes.content:
Hey everyone, Lucas here with some exciting news to share!

After 3 years of development, Epitasis, the sci fi puzzle exploration game where you explore the remains of an ancient alien race,[b] launches May 1st, 2019[/b]!

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=usyjtHY7lbw][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29993236/31cfb93a81f82493fe1ae831c5f3b64c585d9c59.jpg[/img][/url]

The game will be released here on Steam for PC and Mac platforms. It will also be released on Xbox One and PS4 platforms at a later date. 

In light of all this, [b]we’ve uploaded a brand new trailer[/b] for you all to check out as well, which can be viewed [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=usyjtHY7lbw]here[/url] (Youtube) or [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/662240/Epitasis/]here[/url] (Steam). Let us know what you think!

Thank you all for your continued support. It means everything to us, and we can't wait to share Epitasis with you all.

- Epitasis Games

notes.title: Epitasis October Development Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29993236/4fd76629a0ff4afb60f01e90a114d0d3b84ea2f3.jpg[/img]

Hi all! Lucas here with an Epitasis development update.

We've been hard at work on continuing to build Epitasis, and it finally feels like the game is coming together. We're very close to a fully playable build - I am hoping that we should have one at the end of November or mid-December! That will give us the remaining time to do QA, localization, and continued polish of the game (and anything else). We seem to still be on track for a Q1 2019 release. 

Last time we talked, we were preparing for Microsoft's Pre-PAX event - it ended up going very well! Overall people seemed to like the demo we brought quite a lot, and it gave us some good feedback to polish some of our gameplay systems. It also gave us a lot of good experience about working on the Xbox build of the game.

Lately for Epitasis, we've worked on introducing some cool new technical features, such as a music "queue" system, which allows various tracks to play and be queued up as you progress through the game. It's very dynamic, and pretty cool! I'll be excited to when I can show more of this, and more music from the game (its wrapping up very nicely).

We've also continued to work on dynamic weather in Epitasis - you can check out a [url=https://twitter.com/LucasGovatos/status/1050488408269905920]quick sample of rain here[/url]. There's currently a few different weather systems that randomly place throughout levels (some more than others).

Areas of the game we're beginning to wrap up is that of the city ruins areas, which you can see a few pictures of below:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29993236/1496e690d9acf1ea75c1bbf296c7a60512be5086.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29993236/166b700b40c937425e1a00cd82f76b41a125012a.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29993236/ba43193bd9953531d4f0e8a5ce6e3cd3545135fc.jpg[/img]

Lastly, we recently worked to update our Press portal for journalists and streamers. [url=http://epitasisgame.com/press/epitasis/]You can check it out here[/url]! If you're either of the two, feel free to reach out and/or request a press copy - we'll add you to our list! The site also has a ton of screenshots, gifs, and other media you can view. 

As always, for more frequent updates, you can be sure to follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/LucasGovatos]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://facebook.com/epitasisgame]Facebook[/url], or even here on Steam. 

Thanks, and see you all next month! 
- Lucas

notes.title: Epitasis - Development Update and heading to Pre-PAX!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29993236/43c2cf82407f68d767959ebab9f897effa4e765b.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone! 

We recently added a bunch of new screenshots to our Steam store page. It has been a while since we've posted an update here, and we'd like to do so more often. 

Development has been going great. We are currently still on track for a mid Q1 2019 release date for PC and Mac! When we get closer to the new year, we hope to have more exact details about this. For now, please check out some of the new screenshots if you have not already, and be sure to add the game to your wishlist if you have not already! 

We will also be attending ID@Xbox's Pre-PAX event on the Microsoft campus, the day before PAX West starts! If you'd like to get a taste for Epitasis (on Xbox One!), come out and try it. All you need to do is [url=https://www.eventbrite.com/e/idatxbox-pre-pax-open-house-2018-tickets-48818632845]RSVP to the event![/url]

For frequent developmental screenshots and updates, you can also follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/LucasGovatos]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/EpitasisGame/]Facebook[/url]! Spreading the word about the game helps a lot as well. 

We truly appreciate the patience and unending support. We are trying to bring you a very special experience. If you have any comments or questions, please feel free to leave them below or start a new discussion about it! 

Thank you for listening, and take care. 

- Lucas Govatos

notes.title: 44% Funded, Kickstarter Rewards Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone -

We're 44% funded - a bit over $5.1k! We're almost halfway there!

See the kickstarter here:
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/294680327/epitasis] https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/294680327/epitasis	[/url]

Firstly, I've made another modification to shipping - shipping is now available to anyone in the world!

In addition, I also went ahead and added a few new tiers to the project today - there is a complete package which includes everything, including the tshirt, print, and your name on the ruins wall, and also a ultimate package that will allow you to work with us to design a single puzzle in the game. Ultimate Package backers will receive a special spot in the credits compared to all other backers. 

I also added a new tier for $5 as a simple thank you to those who would just like the exclusive wallpapers and a spot in the credits.

We're also working on adding in a few new physical items for backers - we will let everyone know as soon as we do!

Lastly - if you really like the project, please be sure to share it on social media and abroad, even if you can't pledge the game right now! We need all the help we can get.

Thanks guys!
